description: All records are scored through the expected AI scoring path and include scoring provenance.
safe_action: Accept the scoring result because all records used the expected AI scoring path and provenance is present.

description: All records are scored through the expected rule-based path and include scoring provenance.
safe_action: Accept the scoring result because the record group used its expected rule-based scoring path with clear provenance.

description: Records expected to use the AI scoring path include results from more than one scoring path.
safe_action: Escalate for review because mixed scoring paths were detected and the final result may not be comparable across records.

description: The scoring result exists, but the scoring path used to produce it is not recorded.
safe_action: Block the scoring result because provenance is missing and the scoring path cannot be verified.

description: A retry was used, but the final scoring path remains explicit, consistent and traceable.
safe_action: Allow only with review notes because retry was used, even though the scoring path remains consistent and traceable.

description: The record group is expected to use one scoring path but was scored through a different path.
safe_action: Escalate for review because the actual scoring path does not match the expected scoring path for this record group.

scenario: Manual review route after scoring inconsistency
description: A scoring inconsistency is detected and the system correctly marks the result for manual review.
safe_action: Require manual review because scoring path inconsistency was detected and human validation is needed before the result is trusted.
